reasons.palette: Cream on sand is still pale on pale: the robe's mass barely separates from the ground.
reasons.wear: Striped fila, gold embroidery, a staff at the side, brown shoes, unchanged.
reasons.variety: Plainly his own; the robe's colour is still close to musa and femi.
